decisions.reason: Measuring the entire shared 3.3V rail does not change the standalone LDO, source-selection, activation, or load requirements.
The decision concerns INA219 coverage of the 3.3V rail and does not change the independently switched 5V rail.
Current monitoring of the entire 3.3V rail does not alter the sensor modules, their connectors, or their 3.3V supply requirement.
The monitoring-coverage decision does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path state.
The source decision only establishes 3.3V current-measurement coverage and does not change LED supply voltage or data-level shifting.
The INA219 measurement coverage does not change the LED board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The 3.3V rail monitoring decision does not alter BOOT, reset, or associated capacitance requirements.
Measuring the full 3.3V rail does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The current-monitoring coverage decision does not modify USB enumeration or programming behavior.
The 3.3V current-monitoring decision does not resolve or alter the battery connector's electrical interface.
The decision does not change any interboard connector type, pinout, or pin-order requirement.
Coverage of the 3.3V rail by INA219 does not change the 5V LED cutoff behavior, control GPIO, or standby-current target.
